name: CPF (ILRS predictions) Data Source
description: Executable data-source: pulls ILRS CPF v2 prediction files over HTTP on a timer, re-emits them as schema-exact SDS OEM records with the CPF frame preserved as declared, and signs + publishes a PNM pointer.

timers.description: Periodic CPF prediction pull (default every 12h; ILRS analysis centers regenerate CPF predictions daily — a 12h poll catches the daily regeneration promptly, one small file per target).

methods.description: Fetches an ILRS CPF v2 prediction file over HTTP, re-emits it as a schema-exact SDS OEM record (frame preserved as declared), signs a PNM, and publishes it.

outputPorts.description: Signed PNM pointer published for each pulled + stored CPF prediction.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Signed PNM pointer for each published pull.

methods.displayName: Fetch + parse operator ephemeris and emit $OEM (OD-flow guest-link)
methods.description: Fetches the provider catalog via the host http connector (ps::http_get), parses to SDS $OEM in-memory, and emits one $OEM aligned-binary frame per object on the oem port. Nothing stored/signed/published.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Optional node CONFIG (endpoints/target/objectCap); default provider endpoints otherwise.
SDS $OEM ephemeris (aligned-binary), one per operator object. Consumed in-memory by analysis/od.fit; never stored.
